full_name: Jade D’alpoim Guedes | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Jade D’alpoim Guedes is an anthropological archaeologist and doctoral candidate in the Department of Anthropology at Harvard University. She studies ancient plant remains preserved in archaeological sites to reconstruct how ancient agriculturalists coped with changing environments. D’alpoim Guedes is also the founder of www.paleobot.org, an open-access website dedicated to the improvement of identification of archaeobotanical remains.
